heroHeadline: Houthis Claim Dozens of Saudi Troops Killed in Missile Strikes; Saudi Arabia Retaliates
heroSubtitle: Houthi forces claimed their latest missile salvo killed dozens of Saudi troops in what they described as their most significant battlefield victory. Saudi Arabia launched retaliatory airstrikes on Houthi targets following attacks on Riyadh and two Saudi airports, while Syria declared its support for Saudi Arabia and Houthis claimed to shoot down a Saudi drone over Taiz.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
